classification.summary: dynBaseUSDCv3 oracle path (Uni V3 fee tier 42 / zero-liquidity fallbacks) made totalAssets() count only idle USDC, so a flashloan deposit minted inflated shares redeemable for the real reserves.

sources.note: Onchain review: dynBaseUSDCv3 0x67b93f6676bd1911c5fae7ffa90fff5f35e14dcd created 2026-01-17T12:21:51Z (Base block 40932782) by 0xcd231d4ba7b15a4722ac057419d9cd7689e7b8db, not the attack-tx sender 0x5c2cbe53f2ce1b58532d4985a9b9d3db87d3af4c. The vault's 45-byte runtime is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy (363d3d373d3d3d363d73) whose master 0xea7975c2fec1ae9e3058bb5f99d8e26dbc816811 is baked into the bytecode and cannot be repointed; the master's own delegatecall targets 0x3ce426bb2fcb9e1300bbe03e2d34d7b3b7347db5 and 0x4c3df500989df0f6670b99018811b94d591cc5a0 - the other two addresses executed in the victim's context in the exploit trace - are PUSH20 link-time constants in the master's bytecode. keccak(eth_getCode) on the clone is identical at the creation and incident blocks and no EIP-1967 or beacon slot is set, so the deployment basis is exact.
